scientific_integrity: Exact inverse-trigonometric area identity derived from finite signed circular-arc integration; crossing order and the strict rational bound are verified with rational interval arithmetic. Independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the seven specified unit disks are evaluated.
Neither minimum odd area nor minimum number of disks is determined.
The certified translation neighborhood is not claimed optimal.
Historical novelty is provisional relative to accessible literature.
title: Exact odd area and robust sub-\(\pi\) certification for seven unit disks
